description: Repo-scale (aspnet-helpdesk): add pagination to GET /api/tickets that must compose with the existing status/agentId filters, not bypass them
prompts: Add pagination to GET /api/tickets: accept `page` (1-based, default 1) and `pageSize` (default 20, max 100) query parameters, both positive integers - reject with 400 otherwise. The response body changes shape to `{ tickets, total, page, pageSize }`, where `tickets` is just that page's slice and `total` is the count of ALL matching tickets (not just the page). Pagination must be applied AFTER the existing `status` and `agentId` filters, not before - `total` must reflect the filtered count, and the returned `tickets` must be the correct page of the FILTERED result set.
name: add_csharp_helpdesk_tickets_pagination
